task: TASK 1 — EA&B novelty and coverage audit
search_sources: arXiv only where proceedings or publisher text is unavailable
Google Scholar-style web search for forward/backward discovery only
search_queries: UDF optimization tutorial SQL efficient execution
complex dataflow optimization user-defined functions survey
expensive predicates predicate migration UDF cost selectivity
Chaudhuri Shim expensive predicates user-defined functions optimization
Boulos Ono cost estimation user-defined functions
Froid scalar UDF inlining relational algebra
BlackMagic scalar UDF inlining SQL Server
query motion stored procedure optimization loops
UDF vectorization batching JIT compilation database
source-aware UDF cost model control flow graph
physical design procedural UDF access patterns
program cost model control flow learned
inclusion_criteria: expensive predicate or UDF cost representation
static analysis of UDFs for query or dataflow optimization
relationalization or inlining of imperative UDFs
post-plan execution or dataflow UDF optimization
UDF fusion, vectorization, JIT, or batching
physical design influenced by procedural behavior
adjacent work with a representation principle directly relevant to the paper
exclusion_criteria: generic database optimization without a material procedural-representation contribution
generic compiler optimization without a direct representation or database-optimization bridge
application-specific UDF papers without optimizer, execution, benchmarking, or representation contribution
duplicate versions when a definitive proceedings or journal version is available
repository presence alone as evidence of reproducibility

date_range.rationale: No restrictive lower bound beyond the modern relational optimizer era; include historical expensive-predicate foundations and current systems.

venue_scope: Database, data-management, systems, PL/compiler, and software-engineering venues when directly relevant; no venue whitelist.
snowballing_strategy: backward-reference inspection for every central seed
forward discovery of successor systems and papers citing/extending central seeds where feasible
baseline inspection in later UDF papers
survey/tutorial reference-list inspection across multiple representation regimes
canonical artifact and product-documentation inspection for claimed implementations
stopping_criterion: Stop after every mandatory family has authoritative coverage, all central seeds have backward/forward checks, 3–7 strongest competitors are inspectable, and two consecutive query/snowball passes yield no new work that changes the taxonomy, closest-competitor set, novelty classification, or gap ranking.
deduplication_method: Normalize DOI when present; otherwise normalize definitive title, author set, and year. Keep one definitive publication row and record earlier technical-report/preprint relationships in notes. Use separate rows only for materially distinct systems/configurations or product implementations.

evidence_strength_categories.A_PRIMARY_FULL_TEXT: definitive paper/proceedings full text or official product documentation directly supports the field
evidence_strength_categories.B_PRIMARY_METADATA: publisher/proceedings/DOI metadata supports identity but not detailed capability
evidence_strength_categories.C_CANONICAL_ARTIFACT: canonical repository/artifact inspected for availability, license, dependencies, and instructions
evidence_strength_categories.D_AUTHOR_PROJECT: author or official project page supports supplementary identity/capability
evidence_strength_categories.E_SECONDARY_DISCOVERY: secondary index/search result used only to discover a primary source
evidence_strength_categories.UNKNOWN: insufficient evidence; no affirmative capability inference

cell_policy: Every YES or PARTIAL in the decision-visibility matrix must cite an evidence_source identifier present in source_manifest.json. Unclear fields are UNKNOWN; inapplicable fields are NOT_APPLICABLE.
artifact_policy: READY requires inspected source, dependency/build instructions, required data/checkpoints, license, and a plausible compatible execution path. A repository URL alone is insufficient.
experiment_policy: No new experiment, build, install, clone, training, or dataset generation is permitted in Task 1. Existing frozen evidence is read-only.
